scripts.script:
-- Knife Duels | ESP + Skeleton + Tracers + Aimbot
-- Solara | hold E to aim | Salz loaded
if _G.KD_ESP_UNLOAD then pcall(_G.KD_ESP_UNLOAD) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Settings = {
    -- ESP
    ESPEnabled = true,
    BoxESP = true,
    SkeletonESP = true,
    TracerESP = true,
    MaxDistance = 1000,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    SkeletonColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextSize = 13,
    TracerFrom = "Bottom",

    -- Aimbot
    AimEnabled = true,
    AimKey = Enum.KeyCode.E,
    AimFOV = 75,
    AimSmooth = 0.18,
    AimPart = "Head",
    TeamCheck = false,
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOVColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    Prediction = 0.08,
}

local espObjects = {}
local connections = {}

-- corner announce
local announceGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
announceGui.Name = "SalzAnnounce"
announceGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
announceGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
announceGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local announce = Instance.new("TextLabel")
announce.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 36)
announce.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
announce.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
announce.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
announce.BorderSizePixel = 0
announce.Text = "Salz loaded"
announce.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140)
announce.TextSize = 16
announce.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
announce.Parent = announceGui

local ac = Instance.new("UICorner")
ac.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
ac.Parent = announce

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 140)
stroke.Thickness = 1.2
stroke.Transparency = 0.4
stroke.Parent = announce

-- fade after a few seconds (optional, stays if you want permanent)
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(4)
    for i = 0, 1, 0.04 do
        announce.TextTransparency = i
        announce.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + (i * 0.75)
        stroke.Transparency = 0.4 + (i * 0.6)
        task.wait(0.03)
    end
    announce.Visible = false
end)

local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
fovCircle.Thickness = 1
fovCircle.NumSides = 48
fovCircle.Filled = false
fovCircle.Color = Settings.FOVColor
fovCircle.Visible = false
fovCircle.ZIndex = 0
fovCircle.Radius = Settings.AimFOV

local function newDrawing(class, props)
    local d = Drawing.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do d[k] = v end
    return d
end

local skeletonOffsets = {
    {"Head", "UpperTorso"},
    {"UpperTorso", "LowerTorso"},
    {"UpperTorso", "LeftUpperArm"},
    {"LeftUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm"},
    {"LeftLowerArm", "LeftHand"},
    {"UpperTorso", "RightUpperArm"},
    {"RightUpperArm", "RightLowerArm"},
    {"RightLowerArm", "RightHand"},
    {"LowerTorso", "LeftUpperLeg"},
    {"LeftUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg"},
    {"LeftLowerLeg", "LeftFoot"},
    {"LowerTorso", "RightUpperLeg"},
    {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg"},
    {"RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"},
}

local skeletonOffsetsR6 = {
    {"Head", "Torso"},
    {"Torso", "Left Arm"},
    {"Torso", "Right Arm"},
    {"Torso", "Left Leg"},
    {"Torso", "Right Leg"},
}

local function createObjects(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer or espObjects[player] then return end

    local lines = {}
    for i = 1, 14 do
        lines[i] = newDrawing("Line", {
            Thickness = 1.5,
            Color = Settings.SkeletonColor,
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 1,
        })
    end

    espObjects[player] = {
        box = newDrawing("Square", {
            Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Color = Settings.BoxColor,
            Visible = false, ZIndex = 1,
        }),
        name = newDrawing("Text", {
            Size = Settings.TextSize, Center = true, Outline = true,
            Color = Settings.TextColor, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2,
        }),
        tracer = newDrawing("Line", {
            Thickness = 1, Color = Settings.TracerColor,
            Visible = false, ZIndex = 0,
        }),
        skeleton = lines,
    }
end

local function removeObjects(player)
    local o = espObjects[player]
    if not o then return end
    pcall(function() o.box:Remove() end)
    pcall(function() o.name:Remove() end)
    pcall(function() o.tracer:Remove() end)
    for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end
    espObjects[player] = nil
end

local function hideAll(o)
    o.box.Visible = false
    o.name.Visible = false
    o.tracer.Visible = false
    for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do l.Visible = false end
end

local function getClosest()
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = Settings.AimFOV
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                continue
            end
            local char = player.Character
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.AimPart)
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 then
                    local dist2d = (Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y) - Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)).Magnitude
                    local dist3d = (myRoot.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist2d < shortest and dist3d <= Settings.MaxDistance then
                        shortest = dist2d
                        closest = part
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function drawSkeleton(char, lines)
    local isR15 = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    local offsets = isR15 and skeletonOffsets or skeletonOffsetsR6
    for i, pair in ipairs(offsets) do
        local a = char:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
        local b = char:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
        local line = lines[i]
        if a and b and line then
            local p1, on1 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
            local p2, on2 = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(b.Position)
            if on1 or on2 then
                line.From = Vector2.new(p1.X, p1.Y)
                line.To = Vector2.new(p2.X, p2.Y)
                line.Color = Settings.SkeletonColor
                line.Visible = true
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        elseif line then
            line.Visible = false
        end
    end
    for i = #offsets + 1, #lines do
        lines[i].Visible = false
    end
end

local aiming = false

local function update()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y + 36)
    fovCircle.Radius = Settings.AimFOV
    fovCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV and Settings.AimEnabled

    if Settings.AimEnabled and aiming then
        local target = getClosest()
        if target then
            local velocity = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            local predicted = target.Position + (velocity * Settings.Prediction)
            local current = Camera.CFrame
            local goal = CFrame.new(current.Position, predicted)
            Camera.CFrame = current:Lerp(goal, Settings.AimSmooth)
        end
    end

    for player, o in pairs(espObjects) do
        local char = player.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if Settings.ESPEnabled and head and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and myRoot then
            local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= Settings.MaxDistance then
                local headPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0))
                local footPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                local rootPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    if Settings.BoxESP then
                        local height = math.abs(footPos.Y - headPos.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.55
                        o.box.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X - width/2, headPos.Y)
                        o.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                        o.box.Visible = true
                    else
                        o.box.Visible = false
                    end

                    o.name.Text = string.format("%s [%d]", player.DisplayName, math.floor(dist))
                    o.name.Position = Vector2.new(headPos.X, headPos.Y - 15)
                    o.name.Visible = true

                    if Settings.TracerESP then
                        local from
                        if Settings.TracerFrom == "Center" then
                            from = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y/2)
                        elseif Settings.TracerFrom == "Mouse" then
                            from = Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y + 36)
                        else
                            from = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                        end
                        o.tracer.From = from
                        o.tracer.To = Vector2.new(rootPos.X, rootPos.Y)
                        o.tracer.Color = Settings.TracerColor
                        o.tracer.Visible = true
                    else
                        o.tracer.Visible = false
                    end

                    if Settings.SkeletonESP then
                        drawSkeleton(char, o.skeleton)
                    else
                        for _, l in pairs(o.skeleton) do l.Visible = false end
                    end
                else
                    hideAll(o)
                end
            else
                hideAll(o)
            end
        else
            hideAll(o)
        end
    end
end

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Settings.AimKey then
        aiming = true
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Settings.AimKey then
        aiming = false
    end
end))

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do createObjects(p) end
table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createObjects))
table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeObjects))
table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update))

_G.KD_ESP_UNLOAD = function()
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    for player in pairs(espObjects) do removeObjects(player) end
    pcall(function() fovCircle:Remove() end)
    pcall(function() announceGui:Destroy() end)
    _G.KD_ESP_UNLOAD = nil
end

print("Salz loaded")

scripts.script:
-- PLAYER TELEPORTER X + ESP + THRU
-- Single LocalScript | Mobile-friendly | Movable UI

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local espEnabled = true
local espObjects = {}

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PlayerTeleporterX"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 100
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function round(obj, radius)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    c.Parent = obj
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPos, activeInput

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            activeInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == activeInput then
            dragging = false
            activeInput = nil
        end
    end)
end

-- MAIN WINDOW
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 405)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -202)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 27, 36)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Parent = gui
round(main, 12)

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 49, 70)
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Active = true
header.Parent = main
round(header, 12)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Teleporter X + ESP"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 16
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimize.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 32)
minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -43, 0, 6)
minimize.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 110, 180)
minimize.Text = "_"
minimize.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
minimize.TextSize = 22
minimize.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimize.Parent = header
round(minimize, 8)

-- THRU BUTTON
local thru = Instance.new("TextButton")
thru.Name = "ThruButton"
thru.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
thru.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 52)
thru.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 145, 105)
thru.Text = "thru"
thru.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
thru.TextSize = 16
thru.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
thru.Parent = main
round(thru, 8)

thru.Activated:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root then
        -- Move 5 studs forward, based on facing direction.
        root.CFrame = root.CFrame + root.CFrame.LookVector * 5
    end
end)

-- ESP TOGGLE
local espButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
espButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
espButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 94)
espButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 45, 45)
espButton.Text = "ESP: ON"
espButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
espButton.TextSize = 15
espButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
espButton.Parent = main
round(espButton, 8)

-- PLAYER LIST
local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -142)
list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 136)
list.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 49)
list.BorderSizePixel = 0
list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
list.Parent = main
round(list, 8)

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 7)
padding.Parent = list

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name
layout.Parent = list

-- MINIMIZED BOX
local mini = Instance.new("TextButton")
mini.Name = "MinimizedBox"
mini.Size = UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 42)
mini.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, 0)
mini.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
mini.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 49, 70)
mini.Text = "Players  +"
mini.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
mini.TextSize = 15
mini.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
mini.Visible = false
mini.Active = true
mini.Parent = gui
round(mini, 10)

makeDraggable(main, header)
makeDraggable(mini, mini)

minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = false
    mini.Visible = true
end)

mini.Activated:Connect(function()
    mini.Visible = false
    main.Visible = true
end)

-- ESP
local function removeESP(target)
    local objects = espObjects[target]
    if objects then
        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
        espObjects[target] = nil
    end
end

local function createESP(target)
    removeESP(target)

    if target == player or not espEnabled then return end

    local character = target.Character
    if not character then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not root or not head then return end

    local objects = {}
    espObjects[target] = objects

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, highlight)

    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
    box.Adornee = root
    box.Size = Vector3.new(4, 6, 2)
    box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    box.Transparency = 0.25
    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
    box.ZIndex = 5
    box.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, box)

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Adornee = head
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 32)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.MaxDistance = 100000
    billboard.Parent = gui
    table.insert(objects, billboard)

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Text = target.Name
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nameLabel.TextScaled = true
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target ~= player then
            if espEnabled then
                createESP(target)
            else
                removeESP(target)
            end
        end
    end
end

espButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled
    espButton.Text = espEnabled and "ESP: ON" or "ESP: OFF"
    espButton.BackgroundColor3 = espEnabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(160, 45, 45)
        or Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)
    updateESP()
end)

-- TELEPORT TO SELECTED PLAYER
local function teleportTo(target)
    if target == player then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local targetCharacter = target.Character
    if not character or not targetCharacter then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root and targetRoot then
        root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(3, 0, 0)
    end
end

local function refreshPlayers()
    for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if target ~= player then
            local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
            button.Name = "Player_" .. target.UserId
            button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 80, 125)
            button.Text = target.Name
            button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            button.TextSize = 15
            button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            button.Parent = list
            round(button, 8)

            button.Activated:Connect(function()
                teleportTo(target)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function watchPlayer(target)
    if target == player then return end

    target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if target.Parent == Players then
            createESP(target)
        end
    end)

    if target.Character then
        createESP(target)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(target)
    watchPlayer(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(target)
    removeESP(target)
    refreshPlayers()
end)

for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(target)
end

refreshPlayers()

scripts.title: AutoCollect & AutoClick
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if _G.AutoClickerRunId then
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
else
	_G.AutoClickerRunId = 1
end
local myRun = _G.AutoClickerRunId

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AutoClickerGUI")
if old then
	old:Destroy()
end

local function tycoonNameOfClicker(clicker: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return clicker.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function tycoonNameOfGiver(giver: Instance): string
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return giver.Parent.Parent.Name
	end)
	if ok and res then
		return res
	end
	return "?"
end

local function collectClickers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("ClickDetector") and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == "Clicker" then
			local model = d.Parent.Parent
			local mine = model and model.Parent
			if model and model.Name == "Model" and mine then
				table.insert(found, {
					clicker = d.Parent,
					detector = d,
					model = model,
					mine = mine,
					tycoon = tycoonNameOfClicker(d.Parent),
				})
				if #found >= 50 then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function collectGivers()
	local found = {}
	local tyRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
	if not tyRoot then
		return found
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return tyRoot:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return found
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name == "Giver" and d:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
			table.insert(found, {
				part = d,
				tycoon = tycoonNameOfGiver(d),
			})
			if #found >= 50 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return found
end

local entries = collectClickers()
local givers = collectGivers()

local KEYWORDS = { "click", "mine", "drop", "upgrade", "tycoon", "speed", "button", "ore" }

local function nameMatches(n: string): boolean
	local l = string.lower(n)
	for _, k in ipairs(KEYWORDS) do
		if string.find(l, k, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local allRemotes: any = {}
local seen: any = {}
local function addRemote(r: any)
	if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and not seen[r] then
		seen[r] = true
		table.insert(allRemotes, r)
	end
end

local function scanRoot(root: any, cap: number, onlyMatching: boolean)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local ok, desc = pcall(function()
		return root:GetDescendants()
	end)
	if not ok or not desc then
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(desc) do
		n += 1
		if n > cap then
			break
		end
		if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			if not onlyMatching or nameMatches(d.Name) then
				addRemote(d)
			end
			if #allRemotes >= 25 then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	scanRoot(e.clicker, 50, false)
	scanRoot(e.model, 100, false)
	scanRoot(e.mine, 200, false)
end
scanRoot(ReplicatedStorage, 2000, true)

local hasFireClick = (typeof(fireclickdetector) == "function")
local hasFireTouch = (typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function")

local clickNames: any = {}
for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
	table.insert(clickNames, e.tycoon)
end
print("[AutoClicker] Click tycoons (" .. tostring(#entries) .. "): " .. table.concat(clickNames, ", "))
local giverNames: any = {}
for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
	table.insert(giverNames, g.tycoon .. "=" .. g.part:GetFullName())
end
print("[AutoClicker] Money givers (" .. tostring(#givers) .. "): " .. table.concat(giverNames, " | "))
if #entries == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No ClickDetectors found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if #givers == 0 then
	warn("[AutoClicker] No Giver+Attachment parts found under workspace.Tycoons.")
end
if not hasFireClick then
	warn("[AutoClicker] fireclickdetector() missing in Studio. Remote fallback will be used.")
end
if not hasFireTouch then
	warn("[AutoClicker] firetouchinterest() missing in Studio. Collect falls back to teleporting your character.")
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AutoClickerGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 196)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.3, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local dragBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
dragBar.Name = "DragBar"
dragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
dragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
dragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
dragBar.Text = "DRAG HERE"
dragBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
dragBar.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
dragBar.TextSize = 13
dragBar.Active = true
dragBar.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 16
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local collectBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
collectBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
collectBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 80)
collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
collectBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
collectBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
collectBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
collectBtn.TextSize = 16
collectBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
collectBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local collectCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
collectCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
collectCorner.Parent = collectBtn

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 62)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 128)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
statusLabel.TextSize = 12
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
statusLabel.TextWrapped = true
statusLabel.Text = "starting..."
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local enabled = false
local collectEnabled = false
local dragging = false
local dragStart = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local startPos = mainFrame.Position
local fires = 0
local collects = 0
local connections = {}

local function refreshStatus()
	local methodText = "NONE"
	if hasFireClick and #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = "fireclick+" .. tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	elseif hasFireClick then
		methodText = "fireclick"
	elseif #allRemotes > 0 then
		methodText = tostring(#allRemotes) .. " remote(s)"
	end
	local touchText = if hasFireTouch then "invisible" else "teleport"
	statusLabel.Text = "Clickers: " .. tostring(#entries) .. " | " .. methodText .. "\nMoneyGivers: " .. tostring(#givers) .. " (" .. touchText .. ") | Fires: " .. tostring(fires) .. " | Collects: " .. tostring(collects)
end
refreshStatus()

local function cleanup()
	enabled = false
	collectEnabled = false
	dragging = false
	_G.AutoClickerRunId += 1
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	screenGui:Destroy()
	collectgarbage("collect")
end

table.insert(connections, dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: ON"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 85)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "Auto Click: OFF"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, collectBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	collectEnabled = not collectEnabled
	if collectEnabled then
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: ON"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 200)
	else
		collectBtn.Text = "Auto Collect: OFF"
		collectBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
	refreshStatus()
end))

table.insert(connections, closeBtn.Activated:Connect(cleanup))

local function doCollectAll()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	if hasFireTouch then
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 0)
				task.wait()
				firetouchinterest(hrp, g.part, 1)
			end)
		end
	else
		local saved: CFrame = hrp.CFrame
		for _, g in ipairs(givers) do
			if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId or not collectEnabled then
				break
			end
			pcall(function()
				hrp.CFrame = g.part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end)
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		pcall(function()
			hrp.CFrame = saved
		end)
	end
	collects += 1
	refreshStatus()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
		if collectEnabled and #givers > 0 then
			pcall(doCollectAll)
		end
		local waited = 0
		while waited < 5 and myRun == _G.AutoClickerRunId do
			task.wait(0.1)
			waited += 0.1
		end
	end
end)

local hbConn
hbConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if myRun ~= _G.AutoClickerRunId then
		pcall(function()
			hbConn:Disconnect()
		end)
		return
	end
	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	fires += 1
	if hasFireClick then
		for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
			pcall(fireclickdetector, e.detector)
		end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(allRemotes) do
		pcall(function()
			r:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	if fires % 15 == 0 then
		refreshStatus()
	end
end)
table.insert(connections, hbConn)
